title: VIXEN SDI drift gate requires manual merged-header regeneration after source merges
body: The queued sdi_merged_check vixen_codegen_checks gate failed on three stale generated merged SDI headers after the authoring-convergence merge; the documented sdi_merged_regen target had to be run manually before the gate passed. Make the merge/build graph refresh or fail with a located regeneration dependency instead of requiring a lane to discover the repair.

title: VIXEN queued checks do not prewarm shared dependency objects after a merged-tree sync
body: A queued codegen check on the merged tree rebuilt 116 dependency objects before reaching its 24 checks, and the first VixenApp target build then rebuilt a large dependency graph before the scoped retry succeeded. This is a cold-build red under the lane rules: make the shared provider/compiler cache and build tree warm before lane checks, or expose the missed prewarm/key cause so a lane does not pay a full baseline rebuild.

title: Windows native capture lanes require first-run Ninja and ccache provisioning before the target build
body: The queued Windows-native witness could not start the target build warm: build.bat provision found the pinned Ninja tool missing and downloaded it, then configure downloaded/extracted ccache before compiling. The launcher should prewarm or declare these tool/cache inputs for a lane, or surface the exact provisioning state before GPU admission so a benchmark slot is not held by setup.

title: Native benchmark configure path needs explicit Windows cache and toolchain setup
body: The documented vixen-native wrapper could not enable UNDERSET_NATIVE_BENCHMARK through its queued build path; direct CMake without vcvars64 failed stddef.h, and the wrapper's default VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE resolved to a WSL UNC path until I supplied an explicit native cache. A declarative queued benchmark configure action should select vcvars64 and a native FetchContent cache automatically.
